title: Operations Executive
why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 4 skills: excel, word, customer support, admin. Likely PH eligibility signal
why_it_might_not: Confirm Philippines eligibility before applying. Salary not disclosed
position_overview: Company Description Local is a technology platform transforming on-site business payments and commerce across the GCC, operating in Saudi Arabia, UAE, and Bahrain. By enabling customers to make quick, QR-led payments that connect directly to merchants systems, Local helps restaurants, cafes, hotels, and hospitals improve transaction efficiency and gain real-time business insights. The platform is tailored to local market needs, offering reliable, scalable payment infrastructure aligned with regional behaviors and regulations. Backed by 500 Global Sanabil, Local collaborates with Point-of-Sale providers and enterprises to optimize operational workflows and elevate the customer experience. Join us in revolutionizing payments and creating smarter, seamless commerce in the GCC. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Operations Executive role based in Riyadh, with an expectation to travel around the country (mainly Jeddah and Eastern Province). The Operations Executive will oversee and streamline daily operations, ensuring efficient workflows and adherence to company policies. The role involves analyzing operational data, coordinating with teams to resolve process issues, and supporting operational management initiatives to enhance efficiency and performance. A core function will be to support the onboarding, monitoring, and ongoing support of existing and future merchants. The candidate will maintain effective communication with stakeholders, foster positive working relationships, and drive operational excellence in alignment with company goals. Qualifications Proficiency in Operations and Operations Management Strong Analytical Skills for evaluating performance and problem-solving Excellent Interpersonal and Communication Skills for effective stakeholder collaboration Previous experience in a similar role is advantageous Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field is preferred Car and driver's license absolutely essential Familiarity with payment systems, Point of Sale software, or commerce platforms is a plus Please mention the word **FLAWLESSLY** and tag ROjox when applying to show you read the job post completely (#ROjox). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
